sloka: जगाम सरिताम् श्रेष्ठा सर्व पाप प्रणाशिनी ।ततो हि यजमानस्य जह्नोः अद्भुत कर्मणः ॥१-४३-३३॥
transliteration: jagāma saritām śreṣṭhā sarva pāpa praṇāśinī ।tato hi yajamānasya jahnoḥ adbhuta karmaṇaḥ ॥1-43-33॥

translations.english: Ganga, famous and foremost of rivers, destroyer of all sins, flowed in the direction king Bhagiratha moved.
